FN-SL1CT55-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 2
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative David Standridge
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 2 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of various state and
local entities to update pre-existing resources to reflect the renaming of the Gulf of Mexico to
the "Gulf of America."
Page 1
